Name: Weird Recolour (Content Patcher)
Author: sqbr
Description:
This mod colours the dirt, non-crop plants, and water with the blue-ish shading. It's an overlay, so shouldn't affect translations. It doesn't affect the desert or Ginger Island.

Since there's so many images involved I am sure I missed some stuff, if you notice anything that looks off let me know!

Pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13360]Weird Critters[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13348]Blue User Interface[/url].

[b]Mod Conflicts:[/b]
This mod will conflict with any other mods that affect ﻿dirt, non-crop plants, and water, including any that modify foraged plant items like dandelions. Since it's a masked overlay, it won't conflict with mods that change the colour of other objects like buildings, but might cause weird visual effects with mods that do things like add buildings or change their shape. Mods which affect Ginger Island might cause issues with the beach farm since they share some sprites.

[b]Installation Guide:[/b]
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Download the file and unzip.
Put it in the Mods folder.

Manifest.Description: Makes the colours of plants and dirt blueish and strange.
